questions.statement: The clock shows 3:00. How do you say the time in English?
questions.context: In a classroom in Bogotá, a clock on the wall shows 3:00 during English class.

options.feedback: Half past three means 3:30, not 3:00.
Three o clock is correct because the clock shows 3:00.
Quarter past three means 3:15, not 3:00.
Apples are fruit and do not tell the time.

questions.explanation: La expresión o clock se usa para horas exactas. También es fundamental practicar con un reloj real para fijar el vocabulario.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Juan has breakfast at half past seven. What time does Juan have breakfast?
questions.context: In a house in Medellín, a boy eats breakfast at 7:30 before school.

options.feedback: At 7:30 is correct because half past seven means thirty minutes after seven.
At 7:00 is seven o clock, not half past seven.
At 6:30 is half past six, not half past seven.
At 8:30 is half past eight, not half past seven.

questions.explanation: La expresión half past indica treinta minutos después de la hora. Además, relacionarla con 7:30 facilita la comprensión del horario.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Math class is at quarter past eight. What time is math class?
questions.context: In a school in Cali, a girl looks at her timetable for the math class.

options.feedback: At 8:30 is half past eight, not quarter past eight.
At 8:45 is quarter to nine, not quarter past eight.
At 8:00 is eight o clock, not quarter past eight.
At 8:15 is correct because quarter past means fifteen minutes after.

questions.explanation: La expresión quarter past equivale a quince minutos después. También contrasta con quarter to, que indica quince minutos antes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: I ___ my homework at 4:00 in the afternoon. Which verb completes the routine?
questions.context: In a park in Bucaramanga, a boy describes his daily routine after school.

options.feedback: Watch TV dinner mixes two actions and is incorrect grammar.
Do is correct because we say do my homework.
Eat homework is impossible, you eat food not homework.
Drink soccer mixes a drink with a sport and is wrong.

questions.explanation: La colocación do homework es fija en inglés. También es necesario distinguirla de make breakfast y have lunch.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: We have English class ___ Monday morning. Which preposition is correct for days?
questions.context: In a school in Pereira, a timetable shows English on Monday and science on Tuesday.

options.feedback: On is correct because we say on Monday.
In is for months, not for days of the week.
At is for hours, not for days of the week.
By means transport or near, not for days.

questions.explanation: La preposición on acompaña días de la semana. Además, at se reserva para horas y in para meses.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Schedule: 6:30 get up, 7:00 breakfast, 8:00 school. What does Maria do at 7:00?
questions.context: In a house in Cartagena, Maria writes her daily schedule in her notebook.

options.feedback: She gets up at 6:30, not at 7:00.
She has breakfast is correct because schedule says 7:00 breakfast.
She goes to school at 8:00, not at 7:00.
She goes to bed at night, not at 7:00 in the morning.

questions.explanation: Leer un horario exige asociar cada hora con su actividad. También es útil ordenar la rutina con first, then y after.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Art is at quarter to ten. Music is at half past ten. Which class is earlier?
questions.context: In a school in Manizales, two timetables show art and music classes at different times.

options.feedback: Ten thirty is later than nine forty-five.

options.text: Both start at the same time.
options.feedback: Quarter to ten is 9:45 and half past ten is 10:30.

options.text: Neither, because clocks do not show time.
options.feedback: Clocks show time and the two hours are different.
This is correct because quarter to ten means 9:45.

questions.explanation: La expresión quarter to significa quince minutos antes de la hora. Además, comparar 9:45 y 10:30 desarrolla el análisis del horario escolar.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: School starts at 7:00. Luis arrives at half past seven. Ana arrives at quarter to seven. Who is on time and why?
questions.context: In a classroom in Santa Marta, a teacher evaluates two student schedules for punctuality.

options.text: Ana, because quarter to seven means 6:45, before 7:00.
options.feedback: This is correct because 6:45 is early and 7:30 is late.

options.text: Luis, because half past seven means 7:00 exactly.
options.feedback: Half past seven means 7:30, thirty minutes late.

options.text: Both, because 6:45 and 7:30 are the same as 7:00.
options.feedback: Only 7:00 is on time, the others are early or late.

options.text: Neither, because school starts at night.
options.feedback: School starts at 7:00 in the morning, not at night.

questions.explanation: Evaluar puntualidad exige convertir expresiones de tiempo a números. Asimismo, distinguir early, on time y late es clave para la rutina diaria.
questions.subject: ingles
